text:
Doubleshot grants a character a chance to do double (or higher) damage with their ranged or thrown weapon any time they make an attack. Doubleshot applies only to ranged and thrown attacks. (The similar mechanic for melee is Doublestrike.)

If your Doubleshot is greater than 100%, then a second shot is guaranteed, and the remainder is the chance at additional shots. For example:

If your Doubleshot chance is 100%, there's a 100% chance of doing double damage.
If your Doubleshot chance is 120%, you have a 20% chance of doing triple damage instead of double damage.

All damage is multiplied, including base damage, sneak attack, imbue, or weapon enchantments.

Doubleshot values only scale at 50% past a soft cap of 200% (a Doubleshot value of 230%, for example, would only provide 215% chance to Doubleshot.)

Introduction and changes[edit]

Doubleshot was introduced as part of the Update 19 combat changes. Many attack speed bonuses were converted to Doubleshot effects at that time.

Update 28 Patch 1 changes:

Manyshot and Ten Thousand Stars no longer reduce your doubleshot chance.
Repeating crossbows now have 1/3rd the chance for Doubleshot.
Doubleshot can now "wrap" and cause a third or fourth shot if it goes above 100%.

Update 45 changes:

Dual Crossbow combat style (from Inquisitive enhancements) uses 50% of your Doubleshot

Update 49 changes:

Before this change, Doubleshot gave you a chance to make multiple attacks. Now it allows you to do extra damage with a single attack. (This change was made to reduce server lag.)

Update 70 changes:

Doubleshot penalty removed for repeating crossbows and dual crossbows (Inquisitive enhancements)

Feats[edit]
Harbinger of Chaos: +2%
Doubleshot (ML28 Epic Destiny Feat): Passive +10% Doubleshot
Double Shot (Primal Past Life Stance): Passive +3% Doubleshot per stack
Manyshot (Feat): Passive: When using a bow, gain Doubleshot equal to 1.5x your Base Attack Bonus.
Multitude of Missiles (Feat): Active: When using simple thrown weapons, gain +100% Doubleshot for 20 seconds.
Ten Thousand Stars (Feat): Active: When centered, gain Doubleshot equal to monk level * 5 for 30 seconds (only affects shuriken).
Scion of Limbo (Legendary Feat): +16% for 1 minute (one of the eight possible random effects)
Scion of the Astral Plane (Legendary Feat): Passive: +4% and an additional +4% if you are centered.
Shuriken Expertise (Feat): Passive: You are skilled with the use of the shuriken, and gain Doubleshot equal to your Dexterity score while wielding one.
Simple Thrown Weapon Expertise (Feat): Passive bonus to Doubleshot equal to your Dexterity
